headline: Agarwal Eye releases corrigendum to board meeting outcome
hook: Correction issued for Agarwal Eye board meeting
summary: Agarwal Eye Hospital has filed a corrigendum regarding the outcome of its board meeting held on November 5, 2026. The company submitted this correction to the NSE to clarify or amend the previously disclosed details. Retail investors should check the specific nature of the correction in the official filing to understand if it impacts financial results or corporate governance.
why_it_matters: Verify if the correction changes previous financial or operational disclosures.

headline: Dr Agarwal's Health Care board sets record date for eye hospital amalgamation
hook: Consolidation within the Dr Agarwal's group
summary: The board of Dr. Agarwal’s Health Care has approved the effectiveness date and record date for the amalgamation of Dr. Agarwal’s Eye Hospital. This corporate restructuring consolidates the entities under one operational umbrella. Shareholders of record on the specified date will be part of the finalized merger process. For retail investors, corporate restructuring of unlisted or subsidiary healthcare entities can alter holding structures.
why_it_matters: Corporate restructuring alters shareholding structures for entities involved.

headline: Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital updates on amalgamation scheme
hook: Merger progress update for eye care chains
summary: Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital announced a material update regarding the scheme of amalgamation with Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited, involving their respective shareholders and creditors. The board meeting concluded with procedural disclosures required under listing regulations. Indian retail investors should note corporate restructuring activities within listed healthcare entities.
whats_next: Next NCLT or shareholder approval milestone for the merger
why_it_matters: Corporate restructuring affects shareholding structure and valuations.
